tei:div.tei:p: 289) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: pad+ma dbang gi sgrub thabs khams gsum rnam rgyal 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod shin tu zab pa rat+na'i rgya can bzhugs: : 290) na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha ye:

rta mgrin he ru ka la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug bu'i don du: zab mo'i yang bcud yid bzhin nor: pad+ma dbang gi sgrub thabs ni: khams gsum rnam rgyal gdams pa bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: (Dakini secret letter here) de nas sgrub pa'i rim pa la: dben zhing nyams dga' 'tshe ba bral: nyams pa med cing gtsang ba'i sar: yid 'ong dkyil 'khor legs par bkod: kun 'dus gtor ma rin chen 'bar: smad zlum stod zur gsum pa dang: mdun du ut+pal nor bu'i dbyibs: pa tra nor phreng gri thod dang: rdo rje'i mtshan mas laigs par brgyan: phyi nang gsang mchod la sogs bshams: bca' rim sta gon 291) tshang ba'i rjes: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa dang: dam gzung byin 'bebs mchod byin brlabs: bshags pa ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum: lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang: phyag 'tshal mchod bstod nongs pa bshags: 'dzab kyi las rim bcu gnyis rdzogs: sa ma ya: de nas dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: 'od dang 'od zer tshwa tshwa 'phros: yang dag sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: log 'dren bgegs tshogs thams cad kun: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar song: gal te mi 'gro gnas gyur na: bdag nyid khro bo'i tshogs 292)rnams kyis: mtshon cha sna tshogs char du phab: bgegs rnams brlag par gdon mi za: de bas ma gnas phyir dengs shig: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya grī wa hūm̐: log 'dren 'byung po thams cad u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ bzhi dang drag sngags kyis bskrad: gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: mi 'gyur mi shig thig le 'od lnga'i klong: steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i gur du gyur: gzhom gzhig med pa ye shes chen po'i klong: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs kyis glags mi rnyed: srung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i gur du gyur:

oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ḥ gsum pa dam bzung ni: hūm̐: rang rig 'gyur med ye shes lha: rang zhal so ma mjal ba'i phyir: yi dam dbang chen lha tshogs rnams: ye nas 'gyur med srog ltar bzung: tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: bzhi pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings rab 'byams zhing khams na: bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang: khyad par pad+ma dbang chen lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: rnal 'byor bdag la dbang chen bskur du gsol: dkyil 'khor 293)mchod rdzas rnams la byin chen phobs: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad kun sol la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dhah+ya grī wa hūm̐ badz+ra wa ra hi baṃ ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ.a be sha ya a āḥ lnga pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: hūm̐: snang yul thams cad mchod pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: dbang chen lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: rū pa shap+da sogs: ma hā sarba pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye nas rang dang gnyis su med: gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa ci bsags pa: gnyis med bde chen klong du bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bdun pa ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang dngos gzhi'i lha bskyed ni: hrīḥ zang thal brjod med chos nyid de bzhin nyid: 'od gsal gdangs lnga lhun grub rol rtsal las: brtse ba'i snying rje thugs rje'i rgyu ru shar: bh+rūm̐ 'phros dbang chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: dur khrod chen po 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus: chos 294)'byung zla gam dmar po sum brtsegs steng: rang byung dbang gis pho brang mtshan nyid rdzogs: pad+ma nyi zla bdud bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥyig 'phro 'du las:

rang nyid dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing yum la 'khyud: 'og gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa dmar po bsnams: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs bgegs tshogs ma lus mnan: zhal gdangs ljags 'dre+il mche gtsigs spyan gsum ldan: ral pa khams ser gyen brdzes thod skam bcings: dbu gtsug rta mgo dkar dmar ljang gsum 'tsher: dbang chen 'bar ba'i chas kyis rab tu brgyan: khro bo'i chas rdzogs sgeg dpa' rngams brjid ldan: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo ni: dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs yab la 'khril: phag zhal nag po spyi gtsug gyen du ngur: sku la khro bo'i chas rdzogs pheṃ sgra sgrogs: yab yum gnyis med ye shes me klong bzhugs: de yi phyi rim rang las sprul pa yi: sku yi rta phag yab yum 295) dkar gsal 'khril: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: stag gzig smad dkris khro chas yongs rdzogs gsol: gsung gi rta mgrin yab yum dmar gsal 'khrilaḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis= stag gzig= thugs kyi rta mgrin yab yum mthing gsal 'khril: zhal gcig= stag gzig= yon tan rta mgrin yab yum ser gsal 'khril: zhal gcig= stag gzig= phrin las rta mgrin yab yum ljang gsal 'khril: zhal gcig= stag gzig smad dkris khro chas yongs rdzogs gsol: kun kyang ye shes mi dpung klong du bzhugs: dpa' bo ḍā ki sde bzhi khro bo bcu: dregs pa'i sde tshogs sgo ma bzhi la sogs: rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur sogs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por lhun gyis grub: gtso dang 'khor bcas gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min gsang chen rol pa nas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dbyer med bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ brgyad pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni: spos rol dbyangs dang bcas pa yis: hūm̐ hrīḥ

'og min gsang 296)chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug che: pad+ma drag po rta mgrin he ru ka: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo che: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa dang: dpa' bo ging dang dam can srung ma'i tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dam tshig dbang gis byon: log 'dren ru tra 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir= rnal 'byor byin gyis rlob phyir= mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir= bgegs dang bar chad sel phyir= dbang gi phrin las sgrub phyir= ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang: dbang dang drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya grī wa hūm̐:badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dgu pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dam tshig 'khor lo'i rten dang bcas: ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med: 'ub chub ngang du bzhugs nas kyang: 'bad med dngos grub bstsal du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bcu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma rigs kyi lha: thugs rje khros pa log rtog 'dul ba'i gshed: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus la: sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: 297)na mo na ma hoḥ bcu gcig mchod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog ji snyed ci mchis pa: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs nas: dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza hoḥ de bzhin du: bdug spos: mar me: dri chab: zhal zas: rol mo: dang: dhu pe: a lo ke: ghan+dhe/: ne wi d+ya: shap+da: rnams sngags dang 'bul tshig so sor phral te 'bul: hūm̐ hrīḥ stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ji snyed pa: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs nas: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

ma hā rū pa shap+da ghan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharma pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: sman dang rak+ta gtor ma dang: sbyor sgrol bla med ting 'dzin gyi: gsang mchod ji snyed mchis pa kun: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs nas: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 298)oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ bcu gnyis pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs sangs rgyas pad+ma rigs kyi lha: thugs rje khros pa dbang chen he ru ka: log rtog gdug pa tshar gcod drag po'i sku: rab 'jigs gar dgu'i nyams ldan rngams brjid 'bar: dbang drag chas ldan srid gsum dbang du sdud: thabs shes zung 'jug bde stong yum dang sbyor: ye shes me dpung klong du bdud bgegs mnan: dpal chen rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma he ru ka'i: gsung dbyangs mi bzad drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir: gnod byed dregs pa'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon: dpal chen rta mgrin gsung la= sor rtogs ye shes g.yo med nam mkha'i ngang: nyon mongs bdud tshogs ma lus dbyings su sgrol: chos nyid 'gyur med dgongs pa de bzhin nyid: dpal chen rta mgrin thugs la= yon tan mi zad gter la mnga' dbang bsgyur: mchog thun dngos grub sgrub la 'bad med ster: gang 'dod re ba skong mdzad yid bzhin nor: dpal chen rta mgrin yon tan= phrin las 'gro ba 'dul phyir cho 'phrul 'gyed: 299)las bzhi lha tshogs sku yi sras su sprul: gang 'dul sprul pa'i mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: dpa' bo ḍā ki dregs pa'i sde tshogs dang: sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gar gyi rol par shar: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu gsum bshags pa bya pa ni: hoḥ dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni gti mug dbang gis ni: gsang ba ji bzhin ma spyad pa'i:

dam tshig nyams chag ci bsags pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs: sa twa a: bcu bzhi pa 'dzab ni: hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi: thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng: thugs srog hūm̐ hrīḥyi mtha' ma la: sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas g.yon 'khor: 'od 'phros snod bcud kun la phog: rgyal kun byin rlabs nus pa bsdus: 'gro ba'i sgrib bsal bde la bkod: thams cad dag mnyam chos sku'i klong: lha sngags ting 'dzin rol par shar: khyer so gsum ldan ngang nas bzla: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra bha ra hi sarba 300)sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum dang: bye ba gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: dngos nyams rmi lam rtags mtshan gsalaḥ de tshe phrin las sbyor ba brtsams: mchog thun dngos grub thob par 'gyur: the tshom med do sa ma ya: de ni bsnyen pa'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi: thugs srog rang rang sa bon mthar: sngags phreng glog zhags ltar 'phros te: bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: thugs rje nus mthu byin rlabs kun: 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pa ru: sngags phreng la thim gzi brjid 'bar: dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsam: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba lo ka pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum bzlas: de ni sgrub pa'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: 'khor sngags nang sgrub ltar du byas: hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi: thugs srog rang rang sa bon las: sngags phreng dmar po glog zhags ltar: ham̐'u gi rnam par 'phros nas kyang: stong gsum ma lus gang ba yis: khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs bsgral: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi: phrin las gang 'dod 'grub

301)par bsam: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'khor sngags yongs rdzogs mjug tu ni: shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya 'ub 'ub bsdus bsdus sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: mā ra ya rbad dza: zhes pa brgya stong khri sogs bzla: de yis mngon spyod phrin las 'grub: las sbyor rim pa sa ma ya: thun mtshams dbyangs gsal rten snying bzla: mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub len: dge bsngo smon lam ci rigs bya: sa ma ya: bsod nams bsags pa'i thabs zab mo: rjes rim tshogs mchod nyid la brtson: dkar dmar brgyan pa'i ba liṃ ta: māṃ sa dza gad bza' dang bcas: mchod par 'os pa'i rigs rnams bsags: thod rnga rkang gling rol mo dang: phyi nang gsang mchod bkod legs bshams: de nas las rim bcu gsum bstan: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ stong gsum yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: rigs lnga yab yum sa bon las: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen po: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hāḥ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ: sarba pañca ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: 302)hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: dregs pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ka: ma rgyud gtso mo rdo rje phag mo yum: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa dang: dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can srung mar bcas: 'du ba tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: rnal 'byor bdag cag sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: dbang dang drag po'i las 'grub dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi che: dug lnga yongs sgrol rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang: zhi khro rab 'byams pad+ma he ru ka:

dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ma lus 'khor bcas la: bla med gsang chen mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bul: dgyes bzhes tshogs rdzogs dbang gi dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla med gsang ba'i rdzas chen po: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes tshogs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra 303) pū dza khā hi: lnga pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ bdag cag nyon mongs rkyen dbang gis: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma spyad pa'i: dam tshig nyams chag ci bsags kun: zhal zas tshogs mchod 'di yis bshags: dag tshangs dngos grub mchog thob shog: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya= sogs: sa twa a: drug pa bsgral ba bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig pa mi 'gyur bde chen he ru kas: kun rtog gzung 'dzin ru tra ma lus bkug: bdag med ye shes klong du yongs bsgral bas: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags rdul du rlog: ham̐'u ham̐'u pad+ma ki la ya dgra bgegs sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: de nas zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dam nyams dgra bo'i phung lnga 'byung lnga dang: sha khrag rus gsum don snying dmar po bcas: lhag med zhal du bstab bo dbyings su rol: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wa ra dgra bgegs rnams kyi ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hi:

bdun pa tshogs la rol ba ni: las slob kyis thabs shes kyi rdzas thogs te 'di skad bskul: kyai: dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol: 304)gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes dam rdzas longs spyod ni: dpa' bo chen pos dgyes par rol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: e ma:gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnal 'byor kun: thabs shes dam rdzas longs spyod ni: dpa' bo chen pos dgyes par rol: gzung 'dzin dri ma rnam par dag: gtsang rme'i rtog pa kun bral nas: dgyes pa chen por dgongs te rol: a la la ho: mched lcam rnams tshogs la rol: brgyad pa lhag ma bya ba ni: byin rlabs bya zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: dbang phyug ging dang phra men las byed tshogs: dpal gyi pha 'bab bshal skyems gtor ma bzhes: bar chad srungs la dngos grub rgya chen stsol: dbang dang drag po'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: sarba uts+tshiṣa ṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: zhes brjod lhag ma gtsang sar gshegs: dgu pa bskul pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: 'og min gsang ba chen po'i pho brang nas: dbang drag 'bar ba pad+ma he ru ka: gnyis med rdo rje phag mo 'khril sbyor mdzad: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa'i tshogs: dpa' bo ging dang ḍā ki dam can 305) bcas: thugs dam bskul lo chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: ma bcos rdzogs pa don dam he ru ka: gar dgu'i nyams ldan rngams pa'i 'jigs tshul ston: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sngags sgras stong gsum gang: rta skad 'tsher bas srid gsum zil gyis gnon: khro tshogs sprul pa'i las byed skar ltar 'khrigs: gnas 'dir bskul lo mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: rgya 'dre 'gong po zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra: rgyal gshin dam sri bdud sprul la sogs pa'i: rgyal bstan bshig cing 'gro ba'i bde skyid bcom:

gsang sngags bstan la 'tshe zhing bar chad rtsom: thugs dam ma g.yel dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs 'di rnams kyi: gzugs phung rten 'byung 'khor lo dbyings su sgrol: 'du byed dran pa'i 'khor lo mkha' la sbyor: las kyi lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: rgyal bstan dar zhing gsang sngags mi nub brtan: bstan 'dzin tshe srings rnal 'byor bar chad sol: don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin phrin las mdzod: bskul gtor dgra bo'i phyogs su mchod: bcu pa tha tshig bya ba niḥ 306) dmar gtor la dgug gzhug byas te: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min gsang chen rol pa nas: dbang drag pad+ma he ru kas: rdo rje phag mo dpa' bo ging: mkha' 'gro dam can thams cad la: bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dam can dregs pa'i tshogs bcas kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan srog snying phul: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba dang: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring ba dang: phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par chad: tha tshig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ de 'og bar gyi bskal pa la: pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dud khrod nas: rig 'dzin klu sgrub snying po yis: pad+ma gsung rgyud zhal phyes tshe: dam can dregs pa'i tshogs bcas kyis: so so'i= gsang sngags= rnal 'byor tshe= phrin las rnam= tha tshig= phrin las gang bcol= hūm̐ bh+yoḥ de 'og bskal pa'i mtha' ma la: bsam yas has po ri yi rtser: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis: pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: rje 'bangs smin grol gdams pa bstsal: bka' gsang gdams pa'i gnyer gtad tshe: bka' srung dam can dregs pa'i tshogs: so so'i= gsang sngags= rnal 'byor= 307)phrin las= tha tshig= phrin las gang bcol= hūm̐ bh+yo: da lta yang mtha' snyigs ma'i dus: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: rim gnyis zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i phyir: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tsheḥ

bstan srung pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: dam can dregs pa'i tshogs bcas kyis: so so'i= gsang sngags= rnal 'byor= phrin las rnam bzhi= tha tshig= phrin las gang bcol= zhes gtor ma zor du 'phen: bcu gcig pa bstan ma bya ba ni: byin gyis brlabs nas 'di skad do: bh+yo: gangs can bod kyi yul dbus su: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: pad+ma thod phreng bka' bzhin du: tha tshig gnyan la gnas pa'i ma: bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis ni: skyong ma ya ma'i tshogs dang bcas: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba dang: chos log bstan pa bsnub pa dang: rgya 'dre 'gong po bzlog pa dang: gsang sngags snying po'i bstan pa dar: bstan 'dzin tshe srings bshad sgrub sde: 'phel zhing yun brtan phrin las mdzodaḥ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes brjod mchod gtor 308) gtsang sar 'bul: bcu gnyis pa bro brdung ni: gtor gzhong sbub nas 'gugs gzhug byaḥ de steng dpal chen bro rdung ni: hūm̐: dbang chen pad+ma dbang gi lha: dbang drag 'bar ba'i 'khor dang bcas: thabs shes rngams pa'i bro chen brdung: g.yas su bskor te dpa' bo'i bro: zhe sdang rgyal po'i steng du brdung: g.yon du bskor te dpa' mo'i bro: 'dod chags dam sri'i steng du brdung: dbus su bskor te khro bo'i bro: gti mug 'gong po'i steng du brdung: ye shes lnga yi bro brdung bas: dug lnga'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: sarba sha truṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: bcu gsum pa rjes rim mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub blang: de nas dngos grub len pa ni: hoḥ gsang ba rmad byung dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol pa ru: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin mtha' ru phyin: da ni dngos grub stsol re ran: rdo rje srin po'i nam yang langs: lhag pa'i lha khyod dus la babs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga'i:

mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nas: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dngos 309)grub stsol: tshe bsod rgyas pa'i= khams gsum dbang sdud= dgra bgegs tshar gcod= don gnyis lhun grub dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes rdzas la rol: de nas lhag chad bskang ba ni: hoḥ pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum bag med ci bsags pa: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol: zhes yi ge brgya pa dang dbyangs gsal rten snying brjod: de nas bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: dmigs bcas dmigs med dge bsags gang: mar gyur srid pa'i 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sdug bsngal las grol te: bde chen zhing la spyod par shog: de nas smon lam ni: hoḥ dpal chen rta mgrin he ru ka'i: gsang gsum bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bdag cag rdo rje'i mched lcam kun: mi 'bral don gnyis dpal spyod nas: bde gshegs sangs rgyas mngon sum du: mjal nas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun: gdod ma'i mgon por sangs rgyas shog: de nas gshegs bsdu ni: hūm̐: ye shes sems dpa' 'od gsal klong du gshegs: dam tshig pa 310)nyid mi dmigs nam mkha'i ngang: ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i klong nyid du: bsam brjod bral ba chos nyid klong du āḥ de nas lhar ldang ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma dag sgo gsum dag pa lha ru smin: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: gnas gsum 'bru gsum rdo rje gsum du smin: rgyun du 'gro ba'i don la spyod par bya'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: de nas go bgo ni: hūm̐: stong gsal 'gag med ye shes kyi: gzhom gzhig bral ba'i rdo rje yis: 'khor lo lnga yi go bgo'o: 'gyur med gtan srid zin par bya'o: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sku gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs dang:

dbang chen he ru ka yi thugs rje dang: mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mched lcam la: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i= khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud= log 'dren dgra bgegs tshar gcod= las rnams lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: me tog 'thor zhing dkyil 'khor gyi: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: 311) rgya rgya rgya: : e ma gsang ba rmad byung gi: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo yi: gdams pa'i dbang bcud snying por drilaḥ yi dam pad+ma dbang chen gyi: sgrub thabs khams gsum dbang sdud 'di: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i phug pa ru: mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar ma yis: bka' srung dregs pa gsum la gtad: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe: shel dkar skye ba bco lnga'i mthar: su kha badz+ra dang 'phrad nas: gsang ba'i lte yig sa man+ta: chos kyi bdag po las can bdun: chos 'di 'phrad nas don gnyis spyod: the tshom med do snying la 'chongs: gcig brgyud gyis la gsang bar spyod: dam med lag tu ma shor cig: skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: kha gsag the tshom can rnams kyi: srog rtsa dmar 'byin na ra kan: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: (Dakini secret letter here) gu h+ya: brda thim: : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di nyid thabs grogs mchog gyur pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis rin chen su wan dang pañca dbang mdog 'jin pa'i skyes bcas bkas bskul ba dang chos kyi bdag po snyan grags dang rgyal sras 'jigs med dkon mchog dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang*/ rang g-i dngos slob dam pa pad+ma thub bstan bzang po sogs kyis rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇ+ḍal bcas nan cher bskul ngor/ sprang mo mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra gyis chos nyid dgongs pa'i 312) klong nas gdan drangs pa'o// dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//
